english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an adorably cute child, animal, object, or charming person.
Use this for a particularly cute, charming, or amusing quality, especially in a person’s behavior or manner.
Choose this as the all-purpose spoken adjective for something cute, adorable, or charming.
Use 得意 when the thing is interesting because it is amusing, unusual, or charming rather than simply informative.
